title: The Endless Visitor
author: Tamsin Dunmore
blurb: Tamsin Iversen, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must finish the ritual the founders started before the well refills.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
